subject: Request: Consolidated PO & invoice evidence for Nebula AP enrollment
messages:
From: Sophie Reynolds <sophie.reynolds@nebula-retail.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: AP onboarding packet + PO evidence needed

Hi Aditya —

Thanks again for the quick demo yesterday. We need to get Redwood added as a vendor in Nebula's AP system before we can route purchase orders and start payments for the pilot. I attached our AP packet with required fields, but wanted to confirm what you can provide from your side.

Key asks from procurement:
- Vendor legal name, address, tax id / W-9 or W-8 (if non-US)
- Bank details (bank name, account number, routing) OR our vendor-facilitated payment instructions (we can accept ACH or domestic wire)
- Sample invoice PDF that includes a PO reference and line-item breakdown
- The PO acceptance field we require: PO number, PO date, remit-to (electronic remit string)

Attached: Nebula_AP_Packet_20270610.pdf (fillable).

Can you scope which documents you’ll share this week and whether you need any special formatting for the invoice/PO fields? We have a targeted cutover for the pilot next Monday (6/14) and would prefer vendor onboarding completed by EOD 6/12 to generate the first PO.

Appreciate it —
Sophie Reynolds
Sr. AP Operations Manager
Nebula Retail
[Attachment: Nebula_AP_Packet_20270610.pdf (PDF)]

From: aditya_rao@redwood.com <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Reynolds <sophie.reynolds@nebula-retail.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AP onboarding packet + PO evidence needed

Hi Sophie —

Thanks for sending the packet and for the timeline. We can absolutely get the pieces over this week. Summary below of what Redwood will provide and a couple of clarifying Qs:

What we will provide (target EOD 6/11):
- Completed vendor profile with legal name and tax information (PDF): Redwood Inference, LLC; EIN: 12-3456789; HQ: 412 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94105
- Bank mandate / ACH details (we will provide a redacted bank mandate PDF for security)
- Sample invoice (PDF) formatted with a PO field and line items (we’ll include the exact field mapping you requested)
- A short spreadsheet with suggested PO->invoice field mappings for your AP import (I’ll attach an example: Nebula_PO_Example_20270610.xlsx)

Clarifying questions:
1) For the tax evidence, you requested W-9/W-8. Redwood is US-based and will provide a W-9 (do you need an electronic signature or is a scanned PDF sufficient?)
2) For the remit-to field: do you accept the standard single-line electronic remit (e.g., "Redwood Inference LLC — ACH: /acct=XXXX; remit-to: remit@redwood-payments.com") or do you require separate structured fields in your import?

I’m looping in Laura and Marcus on procurement and finance validation. Laura — can you confirm if the sample invoice needs to include invoice-level tax breakdown (state vs federal) or simply a total tax line? Marcus — can you scope whether finance needs additional GL details for the pilot PO?

Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Nebula_PO_Example_20270610.xlsx (Excel)]

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Reynolds <sophie.reynolds@nebula-retail.com>, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AP onboarding packet + PO evidence needed

Hi Sophie / Aditya —

Quick procurement checklist to make sure onboarding won’t be held up: please see inline answers and a list of minimal required fields we will submit.

On W-9: a scanned signed PDF is fine — we will upload that to your portal.

Invoice formatting: for fast ingestion into Nebula's import, our suggested minimal invoice fields are:
- Invoice number
- Invoice date
- PO number (required)
- Line item description
- Quantity / unit price / extended price
- Tax (single line OK — we will include both the tax rate and tax amount in parentheses)
- Total amount
- Remit-to (single-line electronic remit string)
- Redwood GL code (we can provide a default; please confirm whether you need a 6- or 8-digit code)

If you require state-level split in the tax breakdown we can include it, but for the pilot a single tax line will keep things simple and avoid parsing errors.

Attached: Nebula_PO_Example_20270610.xlsx (the same one Aditya referenced) — it has a sample invoice row and a recommendation for CSV column headings that match most AP portals.

Next steps:
- Aditya: upload W-9, sample invoice PDF, and redacted bank mandate to the Drive link Sophie provided by EOD 6/11.
- Sophie: confirm GL code length and whether the PO->invoice import expects a specific CSV header for "Remit-to."

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Head of Procurement, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Nebula_PO_Example_20270610.xlsx (Excel)]

From: Sophie Reynolds <sophie.reynolds@nebula-retail.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AP onboarding packet + PO evidence needed

Thanks, team — this is helpful. We can proceed with the single tax line for the pilot. GL code is 6 digits for Nebula; our import expects a CSV header named "remit_to" (all lowercase, underscore).

One ask before we finalize: can Redwood provide a bank mandate that includes a bank name and last 4 digits of the account (redacted is fine) plus a signed authorization? I attached our vendor mandate form in case it's easier for you to sign into our template.

We will issue a test PO once we receive the invoice sample and bank mandate — payment timeline is standard net-30 from receipt of a valid invoice tied to the PO.

Attaching Nebula_Bank_Mandate_Redacted.pdf (please sign and return)

Looking forward to the pilot —
Sophie
Sr. AP Operations Manager, Nebula Retail
[Attachment: Nebula_Bank_Mandate_Redacted.pdf (PDF)]
